messages:
nina_p: Hey team — first morning setup. Enrolled my M2 Air but when I try to install the corporate VPN (SecureConnect) the installer prompts for a system extension approval and the install fails with "kext approval blocked by MDM". I'm on macOS 13.4.2. Any safe way to get VPN installed without turning off FileVault or disabling SIP?

it_helpdesk: welcome @nina_p :wave: we usually handle that by pushing a kernel-extension approval profile via MDM and then having you reboot. Can you paste the install log line that shows the kext ID? Also confirm device serial (we already have device serial from enrollment).

nina_p: installer log shows: "com.secureconnect.vpn.kext blocked by policy (kext-id: com.secureconnect.kext.vpn)". Serial sent to IT in Okta secure message.

mdm-bot: MDM event: enrollment complete at 2025-03-02T09:05:10Z. Compliance: awaiting extension approval.

it_helpdesk: OK. Two options: (A) we push the kext-allow profile now (recommended) which signs and approves the kext for this device; you'll need to reboot to finish. (B) we can push a temporary admin for 1 hour so IT can run the installer and follow the interactive approval flow. Which do you prefer?

security_ops: policy note  we only approve the specific kext IDs listed in the vendor-signed allowlist. Confirmed com.secureconnect.kext.vpn is on the allowlist. If you installed any VPN from third-party sources before, remove it first.

nina_p: prefer option A, thanks. Don't need interactive help as long as reboot completes the flow.

it_helpdesk: pushed `kext-allow-secureconnect` profile at 2025-03-02T09:12:34Z. Please reboot now and re-run the SecureConnect installer.

mdm-bot: MDM event: kext approval profile applied at 2025-03-02T09:12:40Z.

nina_p: rebooted, installer ran, service is connected. Keychain prompt asked to allow VPN to use system keychain; accepted. FileVault remained on, SIP untouched. All good now :tada:

it_helpdesk: great — we'll mark device compliant. If you see any SSO cert prompts or missing certs for internal services, ping us and we'll re-issue.

nina_p: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround!
